intent.proves: Every asset category that holds an asset has a non-empty name in the default language.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global; at least one subject must be in scope

bindings.reason: Needs authenticated full-payload and scope parity measurement; descriptor existence alone is insufficient.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(g.EcomDetailsGroupSystemName AS nvarchar(100)) FROM EcomDetailsGroup g WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomDetails d WHERE d.DetailsGroupId = g.EcomDetailsGroupId) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomDetailsGroupTranslation t WHERE t.DetailsGroupTranslationGroupId = g.EcomDetailsGroupId AND t.DetailsGroupTranslationLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND ISNULL(t.DetailsGroupTranslationText, N'') <> N'')
bindings.subjectsQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomDetailsGroup g WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomDetails d WHERE d.DetailsGroupId = g.EcomDetailsGroupId)
